content: pdo_sqlsrv defaults to UTF-8 encoding for NVARCHAR bind params (no manual conversion needed). Connection pooling is on by default (client-side pool, not a DB-side pool); returning a connection to the pool triggers sp_reset_connection which resets session state (SET options, temp tables) between reuses - do not rely on session state surviving across requests. Pooling can be disabled via ConnectionPooling=0 in the DSN if needed for diagnostics.
